items.contentSnippet: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了人工智能生成的纳维-斯托克斯千年大奖难题解决方案，包括详细说明和Lean系统中的正式证明。该方案旨在解决流体力学中的核心数学问题，但未提供具体细节。
summaries.en: The article announces the sharing of an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem. It includes a detailed writeup and a formal proof constructed in Lean, a proof assistant. The content focuses on presenting this solution as a significant achievement in mathematics and computational science. The article does not provide further details on the solution's methodology or implications.

items.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
items.content: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.
items.contentSnippet: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.

summaries.zh: OpenAI启动500万美元资助计划，支持独立研究生成式AI对青少年发展、福祉和安全的影响。现开放申请。
summaries.en: OpenAI is offering a $5 million grant program to fund independent research on the impact of generative AI on teen development, well-being, and safety. Applications are now open for researchers to explore these effects.

items.title: OpenAI expands initiatives to support journalism from classrooms to newsrooms
items.content: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.

items.title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
items.content: Engineers at 1Password use Codex to rapidly build new features and internal tools, reaching production-readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies.

summaries.en: 1Password's engineers boosted productivity by 21% using Codex to quickly develop new features and internal tools, achieving production readiness while adhering to strict security standards.

items.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
items.content: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.

summaries.zh: OpenAI、AIRPPU和WAN-IFRA联合启动AI项目，旨在帮助乌克兰新闻机构提升创新、韧性与独立报道能力。该项目将为乌克兰媒体提供技术支持，促进其可持续发展。
summaries.en: OpenAI, AIRPPU, and WAN-IFRA have launched an AI program to assist Ukrainian news organizations in enhancing innovation, resilience, and independent journalism. The initiative aims to provide tools and support to help these organizations adapt to challenges and maintain their operations. The program underscores a commitment to fostering a strong and independent media landscape in Ukraine.
